caption:
The Moon and Venus cuddled up overnight.

The Moon is in Scorpio all day. She met Venus overnight, then sent Mars a friendly sextile early this morning. Swipe for Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Earth friend. 🌙

#earthsigns #taurus #virgo #capricorn #moonjournal

slides.headline: The Moon and Venus cuddled up overnight.
slides.sub: Today's sky for the Earth signs

slides.body: The Moon is in your partnership house, across from your sign. Overnight she met Venus, your ruler: be sweet to your person.
slides.question: Who do I want to spoil a little this weekend?

slides.body: The Moon lights your house of words. Early this morning she sent Mars, in your sign, a friendly sextile: speak up warmly.
slides.question: What do I want to ask for, plainly and kindly?

slides.body: The Moon visits your friendship house. Saturn, your ruler, is retrograde, so it seems to drift backward: call an old friend.
slides.question: Who from my past would love to hear from me?

slides.headline: Save this for a slow Saturday.
